conclusion: With current local assets and standing governance, no route remains that could change the Phase-1 bounded-negative verdict into an admissible positive claim. The negative branch is therefore complete; reopening requires an external governed MSA/coevolution asset, a new corpus with cross-component repeated complete transformations, or a governance change authorizing external datasets.
purpose: Inventory of every remaining legal route toward a positive Phase-1 claim and its current status, so the bounded-negative decision can be checked for completeness.

evidence.reading: No governed UniRef/UniClust snapshot exists; the historical mmseqs40 directories are tiny clustering outputs of local sequence sets (not UniRef), and the largest local sequence JSON holds 147 proteins. Deep MSA/coevolution features cannot be built for the 387 governed targets with current assets; network downloads are outside the local tool policy.

external_datasets_Davis_KIBA.reading: The standing governance authorizes Davis/KIBA training only after a BindingDB candidate passes promotion. No candidate passed; the frozen Davis plan is NOT AUTHORIZED, NOT RUN, and no Davis/KIBA label has been read.

functional_site_annotations.reading: ProteinKG25 GO-bag probes covered 313/387 targets and were worse than the calibrated constant (2.27 vs 1.43). GO function annotations carry no measured transferable cross-component level signal; no ordering-positive was recorded.

looser_transformation_equivalence_classe.reading: A looser-but-principled class would reintroduce the measured mu_tau residual (median 0.269 pK) and needs its own preregistration and cancellation analysis. Per the frozen rules it could only be an identification screen, never the strict core/context positive gate required by the objective.

sealed_confirmation_split.reading: The physically isolated meta_test surface remains sealed; a positive claim cannot be manufactured by opening it outside a frozen promotion protocol.

structure_pocket_priors.reading: Homology-transferred pocket descriptors are not sequence-derived-only inputs and are therefore outside the objective's admissible feature family; even so, their level identifiability was rejected (pocket MLP 2.4398 vs 2.6179 constant on covered subset, barely above shuffled control 2.4941).
